description: This file is the minified source code of the Slick carousel library, version 1.8.0, including class definitions, methods, and initialization code for a jQuery-based slider plugin.

classes.name: Slick
classes.description: Main class for the Slick carousel plugin, encapsulating slider functionality, configuration, and event handling.

methods.name: activateADA
methods.description: Activates accessibility features by setting ARIA attributes on active slides.

methods.name: addSlide
methods.description: Adds a new slide or slides to the carousel at a specified position.

methods.name: animateHeight
methods.description: Animates the height of the slider container based on the current slide's height.

methods.name: animateSlide
methods.description: Animates the slide transition to a target position with support for CSS transforms.

methods.name: getNavTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the target element for navigation if 'asNavFor' option is set.

methods.name: asNavFor
methods.description: Synchronizes this slider with another slider specified by 'asNavFor' option.

methods.name: applyTransition
methods.description: Applies CSS transition properties for slide animations.

methods.name: autoPlay
methods.description: Starts automatic slide rotation based on 'autoplaySpeed'.

methods.name: autoPlayClear
methods.description: Stops the autoplay timer.

methods.name: autoPlayIterator
methods.description: Advances the slide during autoplay, considering direction and boundaries.

methods.name: buildArrows
methods.description: Creates and configures navigation arrow elements.

methods.name: buildDots
methods.description: Creates and configures pagination dots.

methods.name: buildOut
methods.description: Initializes the slider DOM structure, slides, and event handlers.

methods.name: buildRows
methods.description: Arranges slides into multiple rows if 'rows' option is greater than 1.

methods.name: checkResponsive
methods.description: Handles responsive breakpoints and updates slider settings accordingly.

methods.name: changeSlide
methods.description: Handles slide change commands (next, previous, specific index).

methods.name: checkNavigable
methods.description: Ensures the target slide index is valid and navigable.

methods.name: cleanUpEvents
methods.description: Removes event listeners attached to the slider.

methods.name: cleanUpSlideEvents
methods.description: Removes slide-specific event listeners.

methods.name: cleanUpRows
methods.description: Restores original slide structure if rows are used.

methods.name: clickHandler
methods.description: Prevents click events when necessary (e.g., during dragging).

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the slider instance, removing DOM modifications and event handlers.

methods.name: disableTransition
methods.description: Disables CSS transitions for a slide.

methods.name: fadeSlide
methods.description: Fades in a slide with optional callback.

methods.name: fadeSlideOut
methods.description: Fades out a slide.

methods.name: filterSlides
methods.description: Filters slides based on a selector or function.

methods.name: focusHandler
methods.description: Handles focus events for accessibility and autoplay control.

methods.name: getCurrent
methods.description: Returns the current slide index.

methods.name: getDotCount
methods.description: Calculates the number of pagination dots needed.

methods.name: getLeft
methods.description: Calculates the left position for a given slide index.
